sections.title: Requirements
items: ClassicUO + Razor macro client installed and running
The two Razor scripts provided below

sections.title: Loot Bag Setup
sections.intro: You only need one of the following containers:
items: Wooden Box — in your backpack (keep a Copper Key for auto-unlock)
Shipping Crate — on the ground within 2 tiles of your character
sections.outro: All loot you want tracked must be inside one of these when you run the END script.

sections.title: How It Works
items: Run the START script on spot — auto-detects Harvesting, Boating or Creature Farming
Return to your room/house with your loot bag full, then run the END script
Disconnect the game for the log to be created
Click LOAD LOGS in the app — all sessions appear automatically
Dungeons are detected automatically from your in-game coordinates (no manual input needed)

sections.title: Tips & Tricks
items: Always run the END script from your room/house
Keep a Copper Key in your backpack when using a Wooden Box as your loot bag
Multiple characters are fully supported — each gets its own tab
Use the date range calendar filters to focus on specific farming periods
Select multiple sessions with the checkboxes to export or share them together
All How To text is editable in config/howto_content.json
